scope: Local three-page pilot; no deployment or corpus-wide regeneration

new_evidence.design: Unpaired same-survey category summaries; mixed origins, milling and preparation
new_evidence.basis: 45 g dry rice; source rounded mean × 1000/45; approximate converted display retains two significant digits
new_evidence.excluded: Mixed Other category; no new Cd/tAs variety estimates

presentation.comparison_labels: Low / Moderate / High for eligible reference positions; neutral dash otherwise
presentation.mitigation_labels: Neutral shared rating button; no assessed common effect-size scale in existing records
presentation.palette: Original warm gray, blush and burgundy; original three-bar icon
presentation.details: Direction, percentages, comparator and concise interpretation in information-icon hover/focus/tap; full evidence in right overlay
presentation.rating_method: FDA TDS: retain matched-reference group median Q1/Q3; FDA 2013: other compatible same-survey category means, target excluded, equal category weight. Category positions are not sample-distribution, safety or cultivar-effect grades.

checks.browser: Named-category source filter; original 3.5/3.9 µg per 45 g values and eight-category table retained in overlay; mitigation paired effects/percentages retained in overlay; Escape restores trigger focus; no percentages in comparison cells
checks.button_correction: Default forms view now exposes all three rating labels; original source measurements unchanged.
checks.button_correction_visual_check: Browser verified default forms view with Low/High buttons; selected FDA named categories show Basmati Low, Jasmine Moderate, Brown rice High and all eight category ratings; information control exposes references and limitations.
checks.button_correction_build: 107 contract tests + 7 preview-context tests, TypeScript, contract validation, drift and isolated Quartz build pass.

limitations: Scoped evidence extraction and interface verification do not complete systematic review or outcome-level risk-of-bias appraisal.
